title: Sparkle Intel Arc B570 Guardian Luna OC 10GB Graphics Card $265 + Delivery ($0 VIC C&C) @ PC Case Gear
body:
Deal: Sparkle Intel Arc B570 Guardian Luna OC 10GB Graphics Card $265 + Delivery ($0 VIC C&C) @ PC Case Gear

[LilSlip] I mean, 3060 is around 225 on the used market.
I don't understand how this is a 'no deal' when the 3050 had 50+ votes at 199. This is miles better.
[tries] for anyone wondering, it is about on par with a RTX 3060
[Unbreakable] Instead of jumping the gun, make sure to check if YOUR motherboard supports ReBAR otherwise it's an average card at an average price!
[Knightchampion] Anyone know how does this card with xess compare with a the 3060 with dlss. At the same image quality, how do these compare in terms of performance.
[zoRILLA] If you've got a 3060 already, this is not an upgrade.
If you're comparing them, of course the 3060 has better drivers and more vram. It's also 3 years older than the b570, so future support is limited. I would buy the b570 personally, it's also a very good price. Doesn't get cheaper than this.
[Cyphar] 3060 has 8GB vram. B570 has 10GB but your points still stand. The problem with the Arc cards are their drivers were pretty rubbish for some games. I had issues with mine and Cyberpunk, for example. I’m sure that must be fixed by now though and this could be great for a 1080p gaming rig.
[tries] rtx 3060 generally has 12GB of VRAM, later on they came out with a version that only has 8GB, but most still have 12GB
[Naigrabzo] Wow all sorts are coming out of the woods now…. It's like watching a circus but it's not funny.
[vanyellow] just wait for the rx9050 4gb popping up on aliexpress for something stupid like $250+
[Bid Sniper] These are a great 1440p card. I have a a750 and set up a second htpc and its pretty good for the price. Can do 1440p gaming quite well. Will struggle a bit with unreal 5 titles but does those well at 1080p.
Building a Steam machine type system with one of these made me realise dont need 4K RT HDR on monst games to enjoy it.
[sillyhead] I think it's good if you consider that your using it for work and it's under $300 so direct deduction.
[sillyhead] Its really just the 10gb Vram thats necessary…
Just saying its under the $300 cap and you can game proper enough on it. Which is a rare thing.
[Freestyle] lol I know just pulling your leg
I clamed my Dell Monitor last year, since I WFH and can justify it
[8bitsperbyte] If your CPU lacks integrated graphics, then you need a graphics card to drive the computer monitors to display your work spreadsheets and documents 😉
[readerr0r] This is an unstoppable transcoding card in a Plex or Jellyfin server btw. I have one in mine and it hammers through transcodes and has hardware HDR to SDR conversion in Linux.
[flagsarefun] What does it idle at? Seems hard to find a new A310 for much less than this at the moment but concerned the power draw would be higher than the A310
[GoldAlwaysGold] Only good for 7-14B LLM models 27B+ will struggle
[idonotknowwhy] You're not fitting an unlobotomized 14B in this landfill card lol
